body:
The acting verbs' caused answer now carries each record's text: message, file, line, column, error chain and boundary for panics and errors, message and scrubbed fields for logs, from the app, the framework and the engine; the closed-words caused shape (a count per kind and level) and the capture's count-only contract are retired.
The capture keeps text, admits app targets at every level, framework and engine targets at warn and above (engine records newly admitted), never escher targets, and scrubs every source by field name with the sink's content-named set; the message is kept as its author wrote it, an engine record's message included.
The capture installs once per process a chaining panic hook that keeps a panic's payload and location on the capture open on the panicking thread and always runs the hook it replaced; it prints, logs and fields nothing.
Bounds measured and pinned: a text is cut at 1024 characters and says how much it cut; 8 fields, 8 chain links and 16 caused items are kept, the rest counted (fields_past, chain_past, and a new caused_past field on click, type, press, advance and scroll, by kind and source); the content-named set gains password (11 to 12 names).
Six engine warn and error sites now write fixed messages with their values in named fields (href, url, src, text, request), and the engine exposes whether tracing was compiled in; every error boundary, root or own, is registered so a step reads errors new since its marks.
A new founder check installs escher's own sink in process over an in-memory writer at trace and finds no payload or raw href on its lines; CI's Windows job first failed an MCP comparison of caused and passed once the result text was decoded whole by a shared test helper.

The capture installs once per process a chaining panic hook that keeps a panic's payload and location on the capture open on the panicking thread, does nothing when none is open, always runs the hook it replaced, and prints, logs and fields nothing.

The caused answer of click, type, press, advance and scroll carries one item per panic, boundary error and log, in that order, with message, location, an error's chain (8 links kept, chain_past) and boundary root or own; the first 16 are kept and the rest counted in caused_past by kind and source.

Every error boundary, root or own, is registered for the document's life, and a step reads the errors new since its marks from all of them; a dropped boundary cannot be told, so an app remounting many boundaries grows the registry.
The headless stand runs with no sink, except the error-text founder check, which installs escher's own sink in process over an in-memory writer at trace to prove no needle reaches its lines.
Engine and framework warn and error sites write fixed messages and carry their values in named fields (href, url, src, text, request), so the field-name scrub reaches them.
The engine exposes whether its tracing feature was compiled in, so a check can tell a tracing build from a plain one.

body:
The acting verbs' caused answer now carries text: each record's message, file, line and column, its source (app, framework or engine) and target, an error's boundary and cause chain, and a log record's fields, in place of the retired closed-words shape that held a count per kind and level.
Kept text is scrubbed by field name alone: a field named in the content-named set reads [redacted] on every source, an engine record's message included kept whole; password joined that set (11 to 12 names), on the sink and in the capture alike.
Kept text is bounded: 16 items, 8 chain links and 8 fields per item, each text cut at 1024 characters with its cut count; the rest is counted in a new caused_past field (kind, source, count) on click, type, press, advance and scroll.
The scoped capture now admits engine records at warn and above, and installs once per process a chaining panic hook that keeps a panic's payload and location on the open capture, prints and logs nothing, and always runs the hook it replaced.
Every error boundary, root and own, is now read through a boundary registry in the native document; six engine log sites moved their values out of the message into named fields (href, url, src, text, request) with fixed messages.
No new IPC method, socket, port, env var, verb, refusal cause, session error, exit or dependency; CI green on 17 of 17 after a Windows fix to a test's decoding of the MCP result text.

The acting verbs' caused answer now carries text: one item per panic, error or log record with its message, file, line and column, source (app, framework, engine) and target, the boundary (root or own) and cause chain of an error, the kept fields of a log, and the handler id, owner and event; the old closed-words shape (a count per kind and level) is retired.
A new caused_past field follows caused on click, type, press, advance and scroll, counting by kind and source what lies past the first 16 items; texts are cut at 1024 bytes, chains at 8 links, fields at 8, records at 16.
The test-scoped capture now keeps record text, admits the engine's warn and error records (never counted before), redacts any field named in the content-field scrub set (which gains password, 11 to 12 names), and installs once per process a chaining panic hook that keeps a panic's payload and location.
The document now registers every error boundary and exposes boundary marks; the driver reads every boundary's marks, no longer the root error mark alone; six engine warn and error sites now carry their values in fields under fixed messages, and the engine exposes whether tracing was compiled in.
Two new integration targets (the error-text founder check, joining the stand-repeat leg by its prefix, and the panic-hook check) were added; the root-boundary Err check's sentinel reading was inverted; after a red Windows CI run the MCP carrier comparison now decodes the tool result text whole through one shared session-check helper. CI went green 17 of 17.
Counts moved: escher-driver unit tests 121 to 122, escher-telemetry unit tests 21 to 25, the boundary unit tests 3 to 5, the schema field-kind table 30 to 31 rows; coverage floors held, 3 of 3 crates.

body_fields.fact: The acting verbs' caused is bounded: 16 items kept in order (panics, errors new since the step's boundary marks, then records), each text cut at 1024 bytes with its cut stated, 8 chain links and 8 fields kept with the rest counted, and caused_past counting the rest by kind and source.
A caught panic the capture's hook did not see still answers a panic item whose message is the fixed text <payload unread>, so the panic count never loses an item.

The capture redacts a field by its name in the content-field scrub set (12 names, password among them) on every source, engine included, and keeps the message and the other fields whole; checked with password, value, href, url and style value reading redacted.

A check comparing an MCP tool result against the in-process answer decodes the result's JSON string whole through the one shared helper; un-escaping quotes alone leaves a Windows path's backslashes doubled.

The error-text check installs escher's own sink in process over an in-memory writer at trace and reads 0 sentinel payloads or raw hrefs on its lines — an exception to the headless stand running without a sink.
Engine-sourced caused items are asserted only on a build with tracing compiled in, read through the engine's TRACING_COMPILED constant; the founder check runs on both builds.
A check never derives its expected value from the constant its mutation control changes; it pins the measured value as a literal, else the control reads green under the mutation.

The capture's panic hook installs once per process, keeps a panic's payload and location only on a capture open on the panicking thread, then always runs the hook it replaced; a panic outside a capture reads as before, checked by its own target.
